Milan Balinton is running for election to the Santa Clara Valley Water District Board of Directors to represent District 6 in California. Balinton is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Balinton was an at-large member of the Franklin-McKinley Board of Education in California. Balinton assumed office in 2023. Balinton left office on December 13, 2024.
